body: Manish Mohnot (MD & CEO) on 2026-05-15 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "our total outstanding receivables on that business is closer to INR1,600- odd crores. And we're pretty confident that majority of this should get recovered in the first 2 quarters itself" Metric: Water receivables. Target: >INR 800 cr of the 1,600 recovered. Deadline: 2026-09-30. Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-21: unverifiable. Evidence: Aug-26: billed + unbilled still 'INR 1,500 plus crores'; ~INR 650 cr collected by July but new work keeps adding. No Sep-26 receivable figure in the Q2FY27 presentation.
